title: Exploring an azo-uracil based nickel(II) complex for anticancer and phosphatase like activities
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17895-17904
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01587E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Subhasis Ghosh, Samrat Daripa, Tandrim Shyam, Sumit Kumar Hira, Debasis Das
Azo uracil based Ni(II) complex (N1) is cytotoxic to murine colon carcinoma (CT26, MC-38) and human colorectal cancer (HCT-15) cells while sparing normal fibroblast NIH-3T3 cells. It binds to ct-DNA and shows phosphatase like activity.
